hiwStep1Desc: Search for groceries and browse weekly flyers across all local stores from one place. Add items to your SmartCart wishlist instantly.
hiwStep1Detail: Use our search to find products, browse digital flyers, or scan a barcode. We show you real-time prices from every nearby store.
hiwStep2Desc: Our SmartCart algorithm analyzes prices across every partner store and calculates the cheapest combination — even if it means splitting your order.

hiwStep3Detail: Our Trip Saver insight even shows you if consolidating to one store saves you time at a small extra cost.
hiwStep4Desc: One tap adds your optimized selection to the cart. Confirm your order and we coordinate across stores in real-time.
hiwStep4Detail: Each store fulfills their portion. You get the best price on every item with 100% live inventory accuracy.

hiwOwnStoreDesc: Join Spendigo to reach new customers, manage products with barcode scanning, and grow your business online.
hiwA1: Yes! Spendigo is completely free for shoppers. We partner with local stores who pay a small commission — you never pay extra.
hiwA2: We partner with local grocery stores, ethnic food shops, specialty stores, and more in your area. New stores are added regularly — check the Stores page to see who's nearby.
hiwQ3: How does the SmartCart Optimizer work?
hiwA3: When you add items to your wishlist, our algorithm compares prices across all partner stores and finds the combination that gives you the lowest total. It can split your order across multiple stores if that saves you money.
hiwQ4: What if a product isn't in the catalog?
hiwA4: Merchants can add products using barcode scanning or bulk upload. If a product you want is missing, you can request it and we'll work with local stores to add it.
hiwQ5: Do I have to visit multiple stores?
hiwA5: That's up to you! The optimizer shows you both the cheapest split-store option and a convenient single-store option. You decide what matters more — maximum savings or minimum trips.
hiwQ6: How are prices kept up to date?
hiwA6: Partner stores manage their own prices and inventory directly on Spendigo. All data—including flyers and deals—is synced in real-time to reflect what's currently available in-store.
hiwA7: When you're near a partner store with an active deal or flash sale, Spendigo sends a push notification to your phone so you don't miss out on savings while you're already out.
